title: 第5章 技艺第6章 安家费
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 罗德独自回到内城，直奔训练场。
这里仅对亲卫和奥尔德林家族成员开放。
不远处有一座高耸的塔楼，高度超过了三十米。
在卡林邦城已经算得上是个鹤立鸡群的建筑了。
那儿便是邦城的法师塔。
邦城内供奉着14名施法者。
他们各个神秘鲜少出手。
在索拉斯大陆，修炼魔法的门槛要比淬魔修行高得多。
不仅要具备相应的元素感知天赋，而且关于施法者的修炼与传承大多都是不传之秘。
联合奥伦提亚王国的施法者大多出自奥秘殿堂。
偶尔也能遇到那么一两位野法师。
在罗德看来，奥秘殿堂是个类似密宗的传承机构。
对外保持着相当的神秘感。
没有继续关注法师塔，罗德准备进行日常修炼。
扈从用平板车拖来了他的专属甲胄，同时为他换装。
这套全甲重量高达五十五公斤。
要比一般的全身板甲重上一些。
它根据罗德的体魄增加了一定的配重以提升训练效果。
索拉斯大陆其实是有空间饰品存在的。
但它们大多出自各处遗迹，现世存量的极少。
拜伦伯爵的手上倒是有一枚储物戒指，但肯定不会传给罗德。
关于这类奇物的具体制造技术更是早已失传。
据罗德判断，当前这个世界似乎经历过文明的失落。
正处在一种重新萌芽的复苏阶段。
收敛思绪。
他开始以全装姿态围绕着训练场跑动起来。
而后进行刻苦的训练。
在索拉斯大陆，12岁就是修行淬魔之法的年龄门槛。
它分为外练和内修两个部分。
前者需要刻苦的锻炼、充足的营养并搭配特定招式。
后者则由冥想法和呼吸法共同组成。
修炼者首先要淬炼游离的魔力，然后在体内凝聚成魔素战气。
这个过程中体魄会缓缓提升。
等有了足够的积累，便能尝试着让魔素外放形成战气。
它能附在拳脚、武器和甲胄上，大幅提升威能。
初时魔素释放出来是黑灰色的，故而又被称为黑铁战气。
他那两个宣誓亲卫则已淬炼出了更高等阶的古铜战气。
原身因为自小体弱的原因未能及时修行，后又经历了掐脖红。

Rhodes returned to the inner city alone and went straight to the training ground.
This place is only open to personal guards and members of the Aldrin family.
There is a towering tower not far away, more than thirty meters high.
It is already considered a standout building in Kalimbang City.
There is the mage tower in Bangcheng.
There are 14 spellcasters enshrined in the city.
Each of them is mysterious and rarely takes action.
In the continent of Solas, the threshold for practicing magic is much higher than that for cultivating demons.
Not only must one have the corresponding elemental perception talent, but most of the cultivation and inheritance of spellcasters are secrets that are not passed down.
Most of the spellcasters in the United Kingdom of Orontia come from the Hall of Secrets.
Occasionally, one or two wild mages can be encountered.
In Rhode's view, the Secret Hall is a tantric inheritance institution.
It maintains quite a sense of mystery to the outside world.
Instead of continuing to pay attention to the Mage Tower, Rhodes prepared to practice daily.
The retinue dragged his exclusive armor on a flatbed truck and changed his clothes at the same time.
This full set of armor weighs up to fifty-five kilograms.
It is heavier than ordinary full-body plate armor.
It adds a certain amount of weight according to Rhodes' physique to improve the training effect.
There are actually space accessories in Solas continent.
But most of them come from ruins in various places, and very few of them exist in the world.
Earl Byron does have a storage ring on his hand, but he will definitely not pass it on to Rhodes.
The specific manufacturing techniques for such strange objects have long been lost.
According to Rhodes' judgment, the current world seems to have experienced the loss of civilization.
is in a stage of re-emergence.
Concentrate your thoughts.
He started running around the training ground in full gear.
Then train hard.
In the Solas continent, 12 years old is the age threshold for practicing the method of quenching demons.
It is divided into two parts: external training and internal training.
The former requires hard training, adequate nutrition and specific moves.
The latter consists of meditation and breathing techniques.
The cultivator must first temper the free magic power, and then condense it into magic war energy in the body.
During this process, your physical fitness will slowly improve.
After enough accumulation, you can try to release the magic element to form fighting spirit.
It can be attached to fists, feet, weapons and armor, greatly increasing its power.
When the magic element is first released, it is black and gray, so it is also called black iron fighting energy.
His two sworn personal guards have tempered a higher level of bronze fighting spirit.
The original person was unable to practice cultivation in time due to his frailty since childhood, and later suffered from strangulation.
